name: Helmi Fakhriandi Rachman
title: Backend engineer · payments & integrations
summary: Hi, I'm Helmi 👋 I've spent the last six years building payment systems for Indonesia's ATM Bersama network: ISO 8583 switching, QRIS, and the tooling that helps banks get certified. These days I'm also connecting a telecom client's project system to Oracle Fusion ERP. I like writing the test first, making slow reports fast, and handing over code the next person enjoys working on.

experience.company: Pusat Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia (Pusilkom UI) — vendor developer for Artajasa (ATM Bersama Network)
bullets: As the main engineer, designed and built a UAT automation and certification platform for ATM Bersama QRIS in Java 17, Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, JPA, PostgreSQL and jPOS (311 of 371 commits; about 39,000 lines). Its sandbox host simulator runs an ISO 8583 TCP server and a JWT and HMAC-secured REST API, converts JSON to ISO 8583, and is covered by 766 JUnit tests. The tool replaces manual tests and writes the UAT report automatically.
Handed the platform to two developers in Aug 2026 and now mentor them and review their code.

Since Aug 2026, building Oracle Fusion ERP integration for a telecom client's project management system in Node.js, Express.js, Knex, PostgreSQL and React. Delivered over 400 commits in 7 weeks, including ERP ACK file processing, a production PO data migration with rollback rehearsal, and query tuning with materialized views, all test-first with Claude Code (380 new Jest test files).

2025 – 2026: main developer (192 of 322 commits) of a bill-hosting portal for billers in Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, Spring Security, Oracle and PostgreSQL. Built bill upload and validation, payment monitoring, settlement and reconciliation reports, QR code images for payment URLs and broadcast notifications.

2022 – 2025: main developer of an e-money back office in Laravel and PostgreSQL, with maker-checker approvals, fraud and blacklist controls and account lockout. Also built settlement and reconciliation features for a disbursement system in Yii 1.1, Oracle and MySQL, with JasperReports and a Java reconciliation scheduler.

2020 – 2025: built ISO 8583 switching and payment gateway proxy features in Java over TCP sockets in a microservice setup (separate back-end, worker, front-end, proxy, payment and disbursement APIs). Also built a dashboard for transactions worth billions of rupiah.

Debugged and tuned slow reports to cut report and page load times from 15–30 minutes to under 5 minutes on up to one million rows of daily data. Fixed 10 to 50 penetration test findings per project, including all high and critical issues.
Maintained core APIs and integrated third-party APIs, including SOAP services, as part of the integration team.
